distribution.corridor: two or three separators with alternating end gaps; sampled endpoint distance at least 26
distribution.episode_selection: BFS-distance rank bins, final bin replaced by an actual farthest start
distribution.example_selection: all reachable nonterminal cells for every selected goal
distribution.goal_selection: two far-apart BFS-sweep endpoints then distinct random goals

exclusions.known_diagnostic_status: excluded but already observed; not unbiased unseen test evidence

split_policy: globally unique wall layouts including D4 equivalents, excluding all supplied prior split IDs and known diagnostics
